text:
mia: Quick heads-up — we need a short design review for the canary rollout changes (API + SDK + Console UX hints). Goal: agree canary criteria, who runs the canary, and pre-read checklist. Prefer a 30m slot.

mia: Proposed windows (PT): Tue 10:30-11:00, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 9:30-10:00. Please react with :one:, :two:, :three: for your availability.

mia: Pre-read (1 pager + diff + test plan): https://docs.internal/redwood/canary-api-sdk-preread — TL;DR checklist pasted below.

mia: PRE-READ CHECKLIST:
- Read 1-pager (why canary, rollback plan)
- Skim API contract diff (breaking changes flagged)
- Verify SDK compatibility notes (minor semver bump)
- Bring any perf/regression concerns from your stack tests
- Confirm who can approve the rollout on-call (eng-oncall)

jordan: :one: and :two: work for me. prefer Tue if we can get product there.

priya: :two: only. I have a straight-up conflict Tue morning. Can we record?

sam: I can run the canary on Wed afternoon if we pick that slot — I’ll also take notes.

lin: quick question about the SDK behavior — in canary mode we plan to enable `prefer_low_latency` default = true? that changes batching behavior. if so, need to update the pre-read code example.

mia: @lin good catch — yes, the current proposal toggles `prefer_low_latency` for canary to prioritize latency SLOs for the first 10k requests. we should show the snippet.

mia: ```json
{
  "client_config": {
    "prefer_low_latency": true,
    "batch_window_ms": 5,
    "kv_cache_mode": "sticky"
  }
}
```

jordan: that looks fine. we should call out the perf delta (estimated +12% tokens/sec cost). add to pre-read.

priya: noted — pls add an explicit rollback trigger (errors > 3% or tail latency > 2x baseline for 5m). otherwise i can’t approve.

sam: ack — I’ll add the rollback thresholds to the test plan and mark them in the document.

mia: Thanks. Can someone from eng-runtime and product confirm attendance? cc: @jordan for runtime, @priya for product.

jordan: runtime person = jordan (me) + lin for SDK runtime edgecases.

priya: product rep = priya (me). I can carve out Wed if team prefers recording.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Canary review — API/SDK/Console" Wed 15:00-15:30 PT. Invitees: mia, jordan, priya, sam, lin. Link: https://calendar.internal/event/abc123

mia: Perfect. Action items before Wed: 
- Everyone: finish pre-read (mark done in doc)
- Sam: add rollback triggers and test steps (by EOD Tue)
- Lin: update SDK snippet and compatibility notes (by EOD Tue)
- Jordan: bring perf numbers/bench scripts to run live if needed

mia: If anything blocks your pre-read, drop a note here. otherwise see you Wed 15:00 PT. :tada:

priya: Will aim to finish pre-read Tue evening. if urgent, ping me in DMs.

sam: will post test-step PR tonight.

lin: updating docs now, will ping when done.

jordan: added perf numbers to the doc (small change).

mia: closing the loop — recording enabled and will be transcribed. thanks team!
